title: Why Developers Love TypeScript
intro: TypeScript is JavaScript with types. It catches many bugs before your code ever runs.

slides.heading: What it is
slides.subtitle: JavaScript plus a type system.
points: Types are checked, then removed at build time

slides.heading: Basic types
slides.subtitle: The building blocks.
points: string[] for an array of strings

slides.heading: Interfaces
slides.subtitle: Describe the shape of objects.
points: interface User { id: number; name: string }
Typos in property names become errors

scenario.situation: Your backend renames user.fullName to user.name.
scenario.problem: In plain JavaScript, every screen still reading fullName quietly shows undefined in production.
scenario.fix: With a User interface, update the type once and the compiler points to every line still using fullName.
scenario.takeaway: Types turn runtime surprises into compile errors.

cta: Do you write TypeScript or plain JavaScript?
